title.narrative: Supporting Education for Sustainable Development (ESD) and Greening Education in

description.narrative: Building on the work conducted during the biennium 2022-2023 and in follow up to the commitments made at COP28, the ED sector in the Regional Office for the Gulf States and Yemen will support Member States within its constituency in developing actions for greening education in the four dimensions of the greening education partnership (GEP). In particular, this workplan will cover: 1. Mapping the extent to which sustainable development and climate change issues have been integrated into the education systems education in the Gulf States and Yemen; 2. Supporting the development of programmes and tools to further the implementation of green education at school level; 3. Creating repositories of information around ESD and greening education programmes, disseminating knowledge and good practices.
